speaker: SFKast
text: Mind the cables. Some of them are load bearing, and none of them are labeled.

speaker: SFKast
text: Ah. The visitor security keeps radioing about. Come, we should talk.

speaker: SFKast
text: That device on your back. I believe it still has our inventory number on it.

speaker: SFKast
text: Dr. Hale is in the Test Chamber. Follow the shouting.

speaker: SFKast
text: Rusk has been pacing again. If he asks you for anything, use discretion.

speaker: SFKast
text: You have the look of someone who's been reading. Rusk's handwriting, I suppose.

speaker: SFKast
text: Clearance suits you. Try not to abuse it more than the rest of us do.

speaker: SFKast
text: Most of the staff sleep at this hour. I find the crater more honest at night.

speaker: SFHale
text: You hear that hum? That's the array. Beautiful, isn't it?

speaker: SFHale
text: My manipulator! You've been taking care of her? Don't answer, I can see the scorch marks.

speaker: SFHale
text: How's the pull on her? Lifting carts yet? Tell me you've thrown a cow.

speaker: SFHale
text: Kast sent you? Good. I need hands, and you have two.

speaker: SFHale
text: Those crystals sang beautifully. Rusk wants a word with you, by the way.

speaker: SFHale
text: Clearance, eh? Then I'm officially allowed to sell you dangerous things.

speaker: SFHale
text: You'd look better holding a manipulator. Everyone would.

speaker: SFRusk
text: Did you close the door behind you? Please tell me you closed the door.

speaker: SFRusk
text: Wash your hands before touching anything. And after. Especially after.

speaker: SFRusk
text: Crystals for Hale? Wear gloves. They hum right through the skin.

speaker: SFRusk
text: You still have the keycard? Keep it out of sight. Kast notices things.

speaker: SFRusk
text: I've told you everything. I feel lighter, and also terribly exposed.

speaker: SFRusk
text: The truth is out. Strange. The air in here tastes cleaner.

speaker: SFRusk
text: I don't sleep much anymore. The vents make noises at night.

speaker: SFVenn
text: If you came to report a broken thing, take a number. The number is also broken.

speaker: SFVenn
text: Do you know where a man finds a decent wrench in this province? No? Nobody does.

speaker: SFVenn
text: Is that Hale's toy? Don't let him near it. He'll want to tune it.

speaker: SFVenn
text: Fetching crystals for Hale? Bring a spare. I need one for the lights.

speaker: SFVenn
text: So it's all coming out about Wing B. I rewired those doors. Never asked why.

speaker: SFVenn
text: Clearance means you can use the good lift. It still squeaks, mind you.

speaker: SFVenn
text: Sun's out. The solar collector will work for nearly an hour.

speaker: SFPell
text: Oh! Sorry. I thought you were... sorry. Hello.

speaker: SFPell
text: I haven't slept since Tirdas. Or the Tirdas before. Hard to say.

speaker: SFPell
text: Looking for the Director? Up the stairs. Please don't tell him I'm on break.

speaker: SFPell
text: Is that the missing prototype? Could you point it somewhere else, please?

speaker: SFPell
text: People are whispering about Wing B. I don't want to whisper. I want to be elsewhere.

speaker: SFPell
text: You confronted the Director and walked out? Impressive. Truly.

speaker: SFHolt
text: Brennic Holt. Remember the name. It'll be on the Test Chamber door someday.

speaker: SFHolt
text: If you're looking for real talent around here, you just found it.

speaker: SFHolt
text: Hale's gun. Honestly, I'd have built it with a better grip.

speaker: SFHolt
text: Running errands for Hale? Starting at the bottom. I respect that.

speaker: SFHolt
text: Rumor says Kast is in trouble. Shame. Promotions open up in times like these.

speaker: SFHolt
text: Clearance already? Fine. I'm only slightly jealous.

speaker: SFMire
text: Good day. Have you read any local sagas? I'm halfway through one about a bear.

speaker: SFMire
text: Do the stars look the same where you're from? They don't, where I'm from.

speaker: SFMire
text: Lovely morning. The Nords at the crater's edge waved at me today.

speaker: SFMire
text: You're new here. Welcome. Don't touch anything that glows green.

speaker: SFMire
text: You carry that thing like a farmer carries a hoe. It's oddly comforting.

speaker: SFMire
text: I knew some of the people in Wing B. Nobody would tell us anything.

speaker: SFMoran
text: Keep your hands where my officers can see them.

speaker: SFMoran
text: Another civilian. Wonderful. Don't touch the scientists, they bruise.

speaker: SFMoran
text: Director's expecting you. Straight through, no detours.

speaker: SFMoran
text: Kast will want that back. Not my problem unless you point it at my people.

speaker: SFMoran
text: Wing B. They sealed it on my shift and told me it was empty.

speaker: SFMoran
text: Your clearance came through. Armory's open to you. Don't make me regret it.

speaker: SFMoran
text: Night shift. Keep your torch low and your voice lower.

speaker: GuardA
text: Move along. Nothing to see. Well, plenty to see. Just don't.

speaker: GuardA
text: Six months in a crater. I used to have a window.

speaker: GuardA
text: You from around here? Is it always this cold, or is it just us?

speaker: GuardA
text: Hear that? No? Good. Neither did I.

speaker: GuardA
text: The scientists break it, we shoot it. That's the arrangement.

speaker: GuardA
text: Some Nord offered me a bottle of mead for my helmet. I almost said yes.

speaker: GuardA
text: Careful with that manipulator. Last fellow who dropped one lost a toe.

speaker: GuardA
text: Captain says you've got clearance. Doesn't mean I have to like it.

speaker: GuardA
text: If you see something with legs and no face, tell someone. Loudly.

speaker: GuardA
text: Sun's out. So it's only freezing, instead of very freezing.

speaker: GuardB
text: Hey. Don't wander off the lit paths. We don't go there either.

speaker: GuardB
text: I'd give a week's pay for a proper hot meal. Everything here is soup.

speaker: GuardB
text: Was that a dragon earlier? Tell me that wasn't a dragon.

speaker: GuardB
text: The scientists say it's safe. The scientists said that last time.

speaker: GuardB
text: Heard the truth about Wing B. Makes you wonder who's next on the list.

speaker: GuardB
text: Twelve hour shifts and the pay comes in promises. Living the dream.

speaker: GuardB
text: Quiet night. I hate quiet nights.

speaker: GuardB
text: A giant walked past the fence yesterday. Didn't even look at us. Rude.

speaker: GuardB
text: Is that Hale's gun? Does the Captain know you have that?

speaker: GuardB
text: Checkpoint's that way. Keep your weapon sheathed and your manners polite.

speaker: SFKast
text: Variance at four percent. Acceptable. Probably.

speaker: SFKast
text: Someone has moved my chair. Again.

speaker: SFKast
text: The Directorate expects results. The Directorate is also very far away.

speaker: SFKast
text: Remarkable stone. Utterly indifferent to our deadlines.

speaker: SFKast
text: If Hale pushes that array once more without asking, he'll be counting rivets.

speaker: SFHale
text: Come on, sweetheart, give me ten more percent.

speaker: SFHale
text: Who keeps unplugging the capacitor? I know it's Venn.

speaker: SFHale
text: Gravity's just a suggestion, if you ask it nicely.

speaker: SFHale
text: One more test. Just one more. Then lunch.

speaker: SFHale
text: I need more crystals. I always need more crystals.

speaker: SFRusk
text: The specimen moved again. It isn't supposed to do that.

speaker: SFRusk
text: Note to self: stop naming the headcrabs.

speaker: SFRusk
text: Dosage, dosage... where did I write the dosage?

speaker: SFRusk
text: Something scratched the vent last night. I'm sure of it.

speaker: SFRusk
text: Nobody listens until it's too late. Then everybody listens.

speaker: SFVenn
text: My kingdom for a roll of proper tape.

speaker: SFVenn
text: These locals forge swords like artists and can't make a single screw.

speaker: SFVenn
text: Generator two is humming in a key I don't like.

speaker: SFVenn
text: If it sparks, it's fine. If it stops sparking, run.

speaker: SFVenn
text: I fixed that yesterday. Why is it broken? Who touched it?

speaker: SFPell
text: Calibrate, log, calibrate, log... I dream in logs now.

speaker: SFPell
text: Was that a noise? That was definitely a noise.

speaker: SFPell
text: Please work. Please work. Oh good, it worked.

speaker: SFPell
text: I should have stayed in theoretical studies.

speaker: SFPell
text: Holt took credit for my numbers again. Of course he did.

speaker: SFHolt
text: Senior Researcher Holt. Has a nice ring to it.

speaker: SFHolt
text: Hale's methods are sloppy. I'd have finished this weeks ago.

speaker: SFHolt
text: Where are those readings? Does anyone here work except me?

speaker: SFHolt
text: If I'd built the manipulator, it would fold up for travel.

speaker: SFHolt
text: Note: pitch my idea to the Director. Before Hale steals it.

speaker: SFMire
text: Ysgramor sailed from Atmora, and nobody wrote down why he left. Same as us.

speaker: SFMire
text: Sweetrolls. I still don't know what makes them so sweet. I've asked.

speaker: SFMire
text: I wonder what my sister is doing right now.

speaker: SFMire
text: The innkeeper in Riverwood called me 'friend.' Nice word.

speaker: SFMire
text: Nords sing when they're sad. Maybe I should try that.

speaker: SFMoran
text: Eyes up. Something's always watching from that ridge.

speaker: SFMoran
text: Somebody's armor isn't regulation. I'll find you.

speaker: SFMoran
text: Scientists. Can't protect them from themselves.

speaker: SFMoran
text: Fence line held last night. Small miracles.

speaker: SFMoran
text: Who left the canister bay unlocked? I'll find out.

speaker: GuardA
text: Fourteen hours on. Ten to go. Lovely.

speaker: GuardA
text: I swear that rock just moved.

speaker: GuardA
text: Who decided white coats were a good idea in a crater?

speaker: GuardA
text: If one more scientist calls me 'officer person,' I'm quitting.

speaker: GuardA
text: Smells like ozone and wet dog. Every single day.

speaker: GuardA
text: Wish I'd brought a warmer coat. Or a warmer world.

speaker: GuardA
text: Note to self: never volunteer for anything ever again.

speaker: GuardA
text: That's the third canister this week. Who's counting? Me.

speaker: GuardA
text: Somewhere a bard is singing about me. Probably badly.

speaker: GuardA
text: Quiet. Too quiet. I hate it when I say that.

speaker: GuardB
text: Whistling past the crater. Totally calm. Totally fine.

speaker: GuardB
text: Remember when the worst job was gate duty? Still is.

speaker: GuardB
text: The locals think we're mages. I've stopped correcting them.

speaker: GuardB
text: My boots haven't been dry since the day we got here.

speaker: GuardB
text: Headcrab in the mess hall again? No, wait. Just the stew.

speaker: GuardB
text: Hey, crater. Do something interesting. Actually, don't.

speaker: GuardB
text: I could use a drink. Not mead. Anything but mead.

speaker: GuardB
text: One more patrol and I'm sitting down. Captain or no Captain.

speaker: GuardB
text: Saw a fox chewing on a crystal. Fox seemed fine. I'm worried.

speaker: GuardB
text: Somebody tell that generator to stop groaning.

speaker: GuardA
text: Stay down!

speaker: GuardA
text: Back to the Hollow with you!

speaker: GuardA
text: Hit it! Hit it again!

speaker: GuardB
text: Go back where you came from!

speaker: GuardB
text: Keep it pinned!

speaker: GuardB
text: Down you go!

speaker: SFMoran
text: Put it down and keep it down!

speaker: SFMoran
text: Hit it hard, people!

speaker: SFMoran
text: Not on my watch!

speaker: GuardA
text: Argh! I'm hit!

speaker: GuardA
text: It bit me! It actually bit me!

speaker: GuardA
text: Ugh, that'll leave a mark.

speaker: GuardB
text: Gah! It got my arm!

speaker: GuardB
text: Ow! Watch it!

speaker: GuardB
text: Ugh, I felt that through the armor.

speaker: SFMoran
text: That all you've got?

speaker: SFMoran
text: Gah! Hold the line!

speaker: SFMoran
text: Just a scratch. Keep fighting!

speaker: SFKast
text: Ugh! Unacceptable!

speaker: SFKast
text: My arm... ugh.

speaker: SFHale
text: Ow! Okay, that one hurt!

speaker: SFHale
text: Ugh, right in the ribs!

speaker: SFRusk
text: Ah! Don't let it bite!

speaker: SFRusk
text: I'm hurt... where are my gloves?

speaker: SFVenn
text: Ow! Watch the hands, I need those!

speaker: SFVenn
text: Ugh. Worse than a live wire.

speaker: SFPell
text: Aah! It got me!

speaker: SFPell
text: Ow, ow, ow!

speaker: SFHolt
text: Hey! I'm important!

speaker: SFHolt
text: Ugh, this coat was new!

speaker: SFMire
text: Oh! That stings!

speaker: SFMire
text: Please, stop!

speaker: GuardA
text: Headcrab! Headcrab!

speaker: GuardA
text: Contact! Weapons up!

speaker: GuardA
text: Zombie at the fence!

speaker: GuardB
text: Movement! Weapons free!

speaker: GuardB
text: Headcrab on the floor!

speaker: GuardB
text: Zombie! It's a zombie!

speaker: SFMoran
text: Contact! Form up on me!

speaker: SFMoran
text: Hostiles inside the fence!

speaker: SFMoran
text: Headcrabs! Protect the scientists!

speaker: SFKast
text: Security! To the lab, now!

speaker: SFKast
text: Contain it! Someone contain it!

speaker: SFHale
text: Oh, that's a big one! Where's my manipulator?

speaker: SFHale
text: Incoming! Somebody fire something!

speaker: SFRusk
text: No, no, no, it's loose!

speaker: SFRusk
text: Headcrab! Cover your heads!

speaker: SFVenn
text: Oh, great. Something else to fix.

speaker: SFVenn
text: Security! We've got company!

speaker: SFPell
text: It's here! It's here!

speaker: SFPell
text: Help! Somebody, anybody!

speaker: SFHolt
text: Security! Earn your pay!

speaker: SFHolt
text: Get it away from the equipment!

speaker: SFMire
text: By the Nine! That's what they say, right? By the Nine!

speaker: SFMire
text: Oh no. Guards! Guards!

speaker: GuardA
text: Clear. I think. Check it twice.

speaker: GuardA
text: That's done. Somebody log it.

speaker: GuardA
text: Area secure. For now.

speaker: GuardB
text: Clear. Somebody check my helmet for crabs.

speaker: GuardB
text: That's the last of them. Hopefully.

speaker: GuardB
text: Okay. Breathe. We're fine.

speaker: SFMoran
text: Area clear. Report injuries.

speaker: SFMoran
text: Good work. Burn the bodies.

speaker: SFMoran
text: Stand down. Stay sharp.

speaker: GuardA
text: There you are!

speaker: GuardA
text: Found it! Over here!

speaker: GuardA
text: Back again? Bad idea.

speaker: GuardB
text: Got you!

speaker: GuardB
text: Over here! It's over here!

speaker: GuardB
text: Thought you could hide? Wrong.

speaker: SFMoran
text: There! Take it!

speaker: SFMoran
text: Found it. Converge on me!

speaker: SFMoran
text: Got eyes on it!

speaker: GuardA
text: Officer down! Officer down!

speaker: GuardA
text: They got one of ours!

speaker: GuardA
text: Get Rusk! Somebody get Rusk!

speaker: GuardB
text: We lost one!

speaker: GuardB
text: No, no, not like this!

speaker: GuardB
text: Somebody tell the Captain. We lost one.

speaker: SFMoran
text: Officer down! Cover them!

speaker: SFMoran
text: No! Not another one!

speaker: SFMoran
text: They'll pay for that. Push!

speaker: GuardA
text: Fall back! Fall back!

speaker: GuardA
text: I'm not paid enough for this!

speaker: GuardB
text: I'm out! Cover me!

speaker: GuardB
text: Retreat! Get to the bunker!

speaker: SFMoran
text: Fall back to the gate!

speaker: SFMoran
text: Regroup! Fall back!

speaker: SFKast
text: I'll be in my office. Locked.

speaker: SFKast
text: Security will handle this. Not me.

speaker: SFHale
text: Tactical retreat! Very tactical!

speaker: SFHale
text: I'll come back with something bigger!

speaker: SFRusk
text: I knew this would happen! I knew it!

speaker: SFRusk
text: Lock the doors behind me!

speaker: SFVenn
text: Nope. I'm out.

speaker: SFVenn
text: I'll be hiding in the generator room.

speaker: SFPell
text: I'm running! I'm running!

speaker: SFPell
text: Not again, not again!

speaker: SFHolt
text: Someone else handle it!

speaker: SFHolt
text: I'm far too valuable for this!

speaker: SFMire
text: Run! Everyone run!

speaker: SFMire
text: I'm going, I'm going!

speaker: GuardA
text: Hold up. Something's here.

speaker: GuardA
text: Who's there? Show yourself!

speaker: GuardB
text: Did you hear that?

speaker: GuardB
text: Something's moving out there.

speaker: SFMoran
text: Quiet. Something's out there.

speaker: GuardA
text: It slipped into the shadows.

speaker: GuardA
text: Lost sight of it! Spread out!

speaker: GuardB
text: Where'd it go?

speaker: GuardB
text: Lost it. Keep your eyes sharp.

speaker: SFMoran
text: Spread out. Find it.

speaker: GuardA
text: Turn around, civilian. This road is closed by order of the Directorate.

speaker: GuardA
text: Nothing to see past this gate. Go back to Riverwood.

speaker: GuardA
text: No clearance, no entry. Keep walking.

speaker: GuardA
text: Is that... the missing manipulator? Go on through. The Director will want to see you.

speaker: GuardA
text: You're cleared. Watch the canyon, things crawl out of it at night.

speaker: SFKast
text: You pushed the array to ninety percent last night.

speaker: SFHale
text: Ninety two. And nothing exploded. You're welcome.

speaker: SFKast
text: Nothing exploded this time. The logs are not a dare, Marcus.

speaker: SFHale
text: Then stop writing them like one.

speaker: SFHale
text: Give me one full cycle at peak resonance. Just one.

speaker: SFKast
text: The last full cycle gave us Incident Seven.

speaker: SFHale
text: That was containment. My chamber held fine.

speaker: SFKast
text: How comforting for your chamber.

speaker: SFHale
text: Rusk says you sealed Wing B with people inside. Tell me he's lying.

speaker: SFKast
text: Rusk is many things. A liar is not one of them.

speaker: SFHale
text: I built half this place for you, Aurelius.

speaker: SFKast
text: And I kept the other half standing. Pick which half you'd rather lose.

speaker: SFHale
text: Venn, I need the capacitor bank at full charge by noon.

speaker: SFVenn
text: And I need a screwdriver that isn't a sharpened spoon.

speaker: SFHale
text: So can you do it?

speaker: SFVenn
text: Of course I can do it. I'm just going to complain the whole time.

speaker: SFVenn
text: I put in for copper wire. Three weeks ago.

speaker: SFKast
text: The supply rift is unreliable. You know this.

speaker: SFVenn
text: So I traded a Riverwood smith for some. He wanted a lantern.

speaker: SFKast
text: You gave a local our technology?

speaker: SFVenn
text: I gave him a lantern, Director. It's a lantern.

speaker: SFRusk
text: The specimens react to the array cycles. Every single time.

speaker: SFKast
text: Correlation, Emil. Not causation.

speaker: SFRusk
text: They turn toward the Test Chamber. All of them. At once.

speaker: SFKast
text: Then write it up. Quietly.

speaker: SFHale
text: Emil! Want to see a crystal sing at eighty percent?

speaker: SFRusk
text: I'd rather see it sleep at zero.

speaker: SFHale
text: Where's your sense of wonder?

speaker: SFRusk
text: In Wing B. Behind a sealed door.

speaker: SFMire
text: Doctor, are you all right? You've barely eaten.

speaker: SFRusk
text: I keep dreaming about the vents, Ollan.

speaker: SFMire
text: My grandmother said bad dreams are just the mind cleaning house.

speaker: SFRusk
text: Then my house is very, very dirty.

speaker: SFHolt
text: Did you hear? Hale singed his eyebrows off again.

speaker: SFPell
text: Again? That's the third time this month.

speaker: SFHolt
text: If I ran the chamber, nobody would lose any eyebrows.

speaker: SFPell
text: You'd make me run the chamber, and I'd lose mine.

speaker: SFHolt
text: Delegation, Jory. It's a leadership skill.

speaker: SFPell
text: Do you think there were people in Wing B when it sealed?

speaker: SFMire
text: The roster said it was empty. Rosters don't lie.

speaker: SFPell
text: Rosters get written by people, Ollan.

speaker: SFMire
text: Let's not talk about it here.

speaker: SFHolt
text: You actually read those Nord books? They're all about axes.

speaker: SFMire
text: Not all of them. Some are about bears. And honor.

speaker: SFHolt
text: Honor won't calibrate a resonance array.

speaker: SFMire
text: Neither will you, from what Hale says.

speaker: SFPell
text: Mister Venn, the light in my lab keeps flickering.

speaker: SFVenn
text: Does it flicker, or does it strobe?

speaker: SFPell
text: Is there a difference?

speaker: SFVenn
text: One is annoying. The other means move your desk. Now.

speaker: SFMire
text: A woman in Riverwood lit a candle with her finger today.

speaker: SFVenn
text: With what? A flint up her sleeve?

speaker: SFMire
text: Nothing. Just her finger.

speaker: SFVenn
text: Great. They get free fire, and I can't even get a fuse.

speaker: SFMoran
text: Two more canisters spotted near the north ridge.

speaker: SFKast
text: Retrieve them. Discreetly.

speaker: SFMoran
text: My people aren't hounds, Director. They bleed.

speaker: SFKast
text: Then send the ones who bleed least.

speaker: SFMoran
text: I'll pretend you didn't say that.

speaker: SFMoran
text: You told me Wing B was empty.

speaker: SFKast
text: I told you what you needed to hold the line.

speaker: SFMoran
text: My officers were on that door. They heard the knocking.

speaker: SFKast
text: So did I, Captain. So did I.

speaker: SFMoran
text: Listen up. Headcrabs like the ventilation. Check the grates every hour.

speaker: GuardA
text: Every hour, Captain? They're very small grates.

speaker: SFMoran
text: And very small headcrabs fit through them. Every hour.

speaker: SFMoran
text: Nobody fraternizes with the locals while on duty.

speaker: GuardB
text: What about off duty, Captain?

speaker: SFMoran
text: Off duty, you sleep. That's an order.

speaker: GuardB
text: Understood. Sleep. Not mead.

speaker: SFMoran
text: If a scientist tells you something is safe, what do you do?

speaker: GuardA
text: Assume it isn't, Captain.

speaker: SFMoran
text: And if they say it's dangerous?

speaker: GuardA
text: Run, Captain.

speaker: SFMoran
text: Good. You'll outlive most of them.

speaker: GuardA
text: You ever think about going home?

speaker: GuardB
text: Every day. Twice before breakfast.

speaker: GuardA
text: Think they'll ever open the rift for a ride back?

speaker: GuardB
text: They can't even open the canteen on time.

speaker: GuardA
text: Saw a dragon over the mountains this morning.

speaker: GuardB
text: A real one?

speaker: GuardA
text: No, a painted one. Yes, a real one.

speaker: GuardB
text: And we're guarding a giant glowing crater. Perfect.

speaker: GuardB
text: Tried the mead in Riverwood on my day off.

speaker: GuardA
text: And?

speaker: GuardB
text: Woke up in a barn. Next to a goat. Wearing my helmet.

speaker: GuardA
text: The goat, or you?

speaker: GuardB
text: I'd rather not say.

speaker: GuardA
text: Holt asked me to carry his notes. His notes.

speaker: GuardB
text: Did you?

speaker: GuardA
text: I carried them. Straight into the brazier.

speaker: GuardB
text: Officer of the month.

speaker: GuardA
text: What's worse, a headcrab or a zombie?

speaker: GuardB
text: Headcrab. A zombie's just a headcrab with a commute.

speaker: GuardA
text: I really didn't need that picture in my head.

speaker: GuardA
text: You hear what Rusk found? About Wing B?

speaker: GuardB
text: Everyone's heard. The Director sealed it with people inside.

speaker: GuardA
text: And we stood guard while they knocked.

speaker: GuardB
text: We didn't know. Keep telling yourself that. I do.

speaker: GuardA
text: There's a giant herding mammoths near the north fence.

speaker: GuardB
text: Did it notice us?

speaker: GuardA
text: It waved.

speaker: GuardB
text: Should we have waved back?

speaker: GuardA
text: I did. Seemed polite.

speaker: SFHolt
text: Dr. Hale, I reviewed your calibration notes. I have suggestions.

speaker: SFHale
text: Have you built anything that can lift a cart, Holt?

speaker: SFHolt
text: Not yet.

speaker: SFHale
text: Then your suggestions can wait in line behind the cart.

speaker: SFHale
text: Pell! Readings on crystal four?

speaker: SFPell
text: It's humming at a pitch I can taste, sir.

speaker: SFHale
text: Excellent! Write that down. Exactly that.

speaker: SFPell
text: Taste, sir?

speaker: SFHale
text: Science is a full body experience, Jory.

speaker: SFVenn
text: The crater floor sank another inch this month.

speaker: SFRusk
text: Is that structural, or is something underneath?

speaker: SFVenn
text: I'm an engineer. I only answer the first kind of question.

speaker: SFRusk
text: Then who answers the second kind?

speaker: SFKast
text: Mire, I hear you've been visiting Riverwood.

speaker: SFMire
text: Only to trade, Director. And to read at the inn.

speaker: SFKast
text: Say nothing about the site. The locals already think we're star cultists.

speaker: SFMire
text: They also call me 'the polite one.' I'd hate to ruin that.

speaker: SFPell
text: Doctor, is it true? The journal, the people in Wing B?

speaker: SFRusk
text: It's true, Jory. I should have spoken sooner.

speaker: SFPell
text: Why didn't you?

speaker: SFRusk
text: Fear. The same reason you're whispering now.

speaker: SFVenn
text: So Kast is still in charge after all that?

speaker: SFHale
text: The Directorate is far away. And nobody knows the array like him.

speaker: SFVenn
text: Except you.

speaker: SFHale
text: Except me. And I'm the one who kept pushing it.

speaker: SFHolt
text: If Kast falls, Hale moves up, and someone gets the chamber.

speaker: SFPell
text: People died, Brennic.

speaker: SFHolt
text: I know. I'm sorry. I just don't know what else to think about.

speaker: SFMoran
text: Doc, one of my officers got scratched by a crab.

speaker: SFRusk
text: Scratched or bitten? It matters enormously.

speaker: SFMoran
text: Scratched.

speaker: SFRusk
text: Then send them in. And keep them away from anything with legs.

speaker: SFMire
text: Do you miss home, officer?

speaker: GuardB
text: Every hour. You?

speaker: SFMire
text: I miss rain that doesn't turn into snow.

speaker: GuardB
text: I miss being warm. I've forgotten what it feels like.

speaker: GuardA
text: Venn, the main gate is stuck again.

speaker: SFVenn
text: Did you kick it?

speaker: GuardA
text: Yes.

speaker: SFVenn
text: Kick it lower. That's the whole repair.

speaker: SFKast
text: Far enough that the answer would mean nothing to you.

speaker: SFKast
text: Let's leave it at that.

speaker: SFKast
text: Starfall Research Site. We study the crystal that fell here a year ago.

speaker: SFKast
text: We are the Lambda Directorate. Scholars, mostly. Far from home, entirely.

speaker: SFKast
text: Your mages would say so. We prefer equations. They're less temperamental.

speaker: SFKast
text: The star struck hard enough to melt the bedrock into glass.

speaker: SFKast
text: Its heart was a crystal that stores energy from nothing. Zero-point energy.

speaker: SFKast
text: Hale is brilliant and reckless. Rusk is careful and frightened.

speaker: SFKast
text: Venn keeps the lights on. The juniors keep me humble, mostly by breaking things.

speaker: SFKast
text: Fauna from the Hollow, a neighboring space our experiments brushed against.

speaker: SFKast
text: The parasites are called headcrabs. Unpleasant, but manageable. Mostly.

speaker: SFKast
text: A province of shouting men, flying lizards, and alarmingly good mead.

speaker: SFKast
text: I admire the Nords. They solve problems with confidence, if not accuracy.

speaker: SFKast
text: A containment fault in Wing B. Regrettable. Resolved.

speaker: SFKast
text: Let's not dwell on it. Rumor makes a poor scientist.

speaker: SFHale
text: I run the Test Chamber. Crystals go in, wonders come out.

speaker: SFHale
text: Sometimes sparks come out. Sometimes the wonders come out sideways.

speaker: SFHale
text: The crystal is the heart. Every pull borrows energy from the field.

speaker: SFHale
text: Feed it crystals, and it'll love you back.

speaker: SFHale
text: A junior panicked after Incident Seven and ran off with a prototype.

speaker: SFHale
text: Smart kid, honestly. Picked the best one.

speaker: SFHale
text: The Zero-Point Field Manipulator. My masterpiece. Pulls, pushes, and hurls like a dancer.

speaker: SFHale
text: Well. A dancer with a very strong grip.

speaker: SFHale
text: Aurelius is the smartest man I know. Also the most cautious, which is a waste.

speaker: SFHale
text: He wants the array at half power. Half! Like eating half a sweetroll.

speaker: SFHale
text: A border world. Ours rubs up against it when the crystals resonate.

speaker: SFHale
text: Gray light, no wind, and things that think we're dinner. Fascinating place.

speaker: SFHale
text: Love it. Dragons! Actual dragons! Do you know the lift on those wings?

speaker: SFHale
text: I've been trying to get a dragon scale under the lens for months.

speaker: SFRusk
text: Xenobiology. The parasites from the Hollow, mostly. How they feed, how they bond.

speaker: SFRusk
text: I used to find it fascinating. Now I mostly find it in my nightmares.

speaker: SFRusk
text: I've tried. Every time. I'm sorry, the answer is no.

speaker: SFRusk
text: Aim for the parasite, not the host. And keep your head covered.

speaker: SFRusk
text: They latch onto the head and fuse with the nervous system.

speaker: SFRusk
text: The host keeps walking. Keeps groaning. Whether anyone's still inside, I can't say.

speaker: SFRusk
text: The Director is brilliant. And he keeps secrets the way others keep pets.

speaker: SFRusk
text: Carefully. Lovingly. Behind locked doors.

speaker: SFRusk
text: I study things that climb into people's skulls. Of course I'm frightened.

speaker: SFRusk
text: The only sane people here are the frightened ones.

speaker: SFRusk
text: I can't talk about that. Not here. Not yet.

speaker: SFVenn
text: I keep the resonance array from shaking itself apart. And the generators. And the lights.

speaker: SFVenn
text: If it works, that's me. If it doesn't, that's also me, apparently.

speaker: SFVenn
text: Iron ingots, if you see any. Real tools, if you find a miracle.

speaker: SFVenn
text: This province has a thousand ways to sharpen a sword and zero ways to make a bolt.

speaker: SFVenn
text: I traded a smith a lantern for copper wire. He thinks it's sorcery.

speaker: SFVenn
text: Crystals vibrate. We amplify the vibration. Reality gets nervous.

speaker: SFVenn
text: Push it too far and reality gets more than nervous. That's Hale's favorite part.

speaker: SFVenn
text: Hale plays my generators like a drum. I treat his requests like weather.

speaker: SFVenn
text: Something to complain about, and nothing I can stop.

speaker: SFVenn
text: A fellow in Whiterun froze a puddle by glaring at it. I've stopped asking questions.

speaker: SFVenn
text: And some old court wizard in Windhelm bought our notes. Wuunferth. Built a crystal trap from them.

speaker: SFMoran
text: Keep the fence up, the creatures out, and the scientists alive. In that order.

speaker: SFMoran
text: Some days I'd swap the last two.

speaker: SFMoran
text: Good people. Tired people. Nine of them, on a site that needs thirty.

speaker: SFMoran
text: They didn't sign up for crabs. They signed up for a paycheck and a view.

speaker: SFMoran
text: Canisters. The rifts spit them out all over these mountains.

speaker: SFMoran
text: My people haul them in when they can. Some trips, not everyone comes back.

speaker: SFMoran
text: Zombies are slow. Crabs are fast. Kill the fast ones first.

speaker: SFMoran
text: And never let one onto your face. That's the whole training.

speaker: SFMoran
text: They're smart. Smart people make the biggest messes.

speaker: SFMoran
text: Rusk is all right. He worries. I trust the ones who worry.

speaker: SFMoran
text: Not without clearance. And clearance comes from the Director.

speaker: SFMoran
text: You've got clearance. The chest is unlocked. Take what you need.

speaker: SFPell
text: Readings. Logs. More readings. And I fetch things for Dr. Hale.

speaker: SFPell
text: Sometimes I fetch Dr. Hale, when the fumes knock him over.

speaker: SFPell
text: Nervous? Me? I just jump at shadows. The shadows here have teeth.

speaker: SFPell
text: Oh. Yes. One of us, a junior like me. Ran toward Riverwood after Incident Seven.

speaker: SFPell
text: Honestly? Some nights I wish I'd gone too.

speaker: SFHolt
text: Senior researcher in a year. Test Chamber in two. Director in five.

speaker: SFHolt
text: Write that down. You'll want to say you knew me.

speaker: SFHolt
text: Talented. Loud. Overdue for retirement, if you ask me. Nobody asks me.

speaker: SFHolt
text: Cold. Loud. Everyone thinks a beard counts as a personality.

speaker: SFHolt
text: Though I'll admit, the mead grows on you.

speaker: SFMire
text: A saga about a Nord who wrestled a bear to win a bride.

speaker: SFMire
text: I'm not sure who won. I'm not sure the bear knew either.

speaker: SFMire
text: Every day. But Riverwood is kind. People share bread without asking why.

speaker: SFMire
text: They call it the falling star. Some think we're its priests.

speaker: SFMire
text: A farmer brought us cheese as an offering. We kept the cheese.

speaker: SFKast
text: Well. You've brought back our missing prototype. Hale will be insufferable.

speaker: SFKast
text: A junior took it in a panic. How it reached your hands, I won't ask. Yet.

speaker: SFKast
text: Make yourself useful. Report to Dr. Hale in the Test Chamber.

speaker: SFHale
text: Fresh hands! Wonderful. I need energy crystals. Three of them.

speaker: SFHale
text: Embershard Mine near Riverwood is full of them. Bring three back to me.

speaker: SFHale
text: Look at them glow! These are perfect.

speaker: SFHale
text: Rusk was asking after you. See him before he chews through his gloves.

speaker: SFHale
text: Always. But trading with outsiders needs Directorate Clearance.

speaker: SFHale
text: Get the Director to sign off, and my stock is yours.

speaker: SFHale
text: Step right up. Crystals, fresh from the crater.

speaker: SFRusk
text: Yes. Quietly, please. My research journal is in Containment Wing B.

speaker: SFRusk
text: It was sealed during Incident Seven. I need it back. Take my keycard.

speaker: SFRusk
text: Be careful in there. Things may still be moving.

speaker: SFRusk
text: Down the east stairs, past the decontamination showers. The journal is in my old office.

speaker: SFRusk
text: And don't let the Director see you go.

speaker: SFRusk
text: Four researchers and two officers. They knocked on that door for hours.

speaker: SFRusk
text: Because you're not one of us. Kast can't silence you with a transfer.

speaker: SFRusk
text: Go to him. Make him say it out loud.

speaker: SFRusk
text: You found it. Thank you. Now you should know what's in it.

speaker: SFRusk
text: Kast ordered Wing B sealed during Incident Seven. Our people were still inside.

speaker: SFRusk
text: Then he buried the report. I signed the false roster. Now you know.

speaker: SFKast
text: Perhaps it is. I'll carry it either way.

speaker: SFKast
text: But you've earned the truth, and something more. You now hold Directorate Clearance.

speaker: SFKast
text: Hale will trade with you, and Moran will open the armory. Use them better than I did.

speaker: SFKast
text: Understanding. I hadn't expected that from anyone.

speaker: SFKast
text: Then take this as thanks. You now hold Directorate Clearance.

speaker: SFKast
text: Hale's stock and Moran's armory are open to you. Keep this site honest. I couldn't.

speaker: SFKast
text: So he finally found his courage. Good for him.

speaker: SFKast
text: Yes. I sealed Wing B. The hosts were at the door. Seconds mattered.

speaker: SFKast
text: Six lives against the whole site, and perhaps Riverwood. I chose. Now you judge.
